name: WebBrowserControl
description: Represents a web browser control on a form.
remarks: Use the ControlSource property to specify the webpage to load in the control.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Use the Application property to access the active Microsoft Access Application object and its related properties. Read-only Application object.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: OldValue
properties.description: Use the OldValue property to determine the unedited value of a bound control. Read-only Variant.

properties.name: Properties
properties.description: Returns a reference to a control's Properties collection object. Read-only.

properties.name: Controls
properties.description: Returns the Controls collection of a form, subform, report, or section. Read-only Controls.

properties.name: Hyperlink
properties.description: Use the Hyperlink property to return a reference to a Hyperlink object and to access the properties and methods of a control's hyperlink. Read-only.

properties.name: Value
properties.description: Determines or specifies the text in the control. Read/write Variant.

properties.name: ControlSource
properties.description: Use the ControlSource property to specify what data appears in a control. You can display and edit data bound to a field in a table, query, or SQL statement. You can also display the result of an expression. Read/write String.

properties.name: DisplayWhen
properties.description: Use the DisplayWhen property to specify which of a form's controls you want displayed on screen and in print. Read/write Byte.

properties.name: Enabled
properties.description: Use the Enabled property to set or return the status of the conditional format in the FormatCondition object. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: ReadyState
properties.description: Gets the status of the specified web browser control. Read-only AcWebBrowserState.

properties.name: Progress
properties.description: Specifies the amount of total progress of a download operation. Read-only Long.

properties.name: ScrollBars
properties.description: Use the ScrollBars property to specify whether scroll bars appear on a control. Read/write Byte.

properties.name: ScrollTop
properties.description: Gets or sets the distance, in pixels, between the top edge of the WebBrowserControl object and the topmost portion of the content currently visible in the control. Read/write Long.

properties.name: ScrollLeft
properties.description: Gets or sets the distance, in pixels, between the left edge of the WebBrowserControl object and the leftmost portion of the content currently visible in the control. Read/write Long.

properties.name: Transform
properties.description: Read/write.

properties.name: LocationURL
properties.description: Gets the Uniform Resource Locator (URL) of the current document. Read-only String.

properties.name: Object
properties.description: Use the Object property in Visual Basic to return a reference to the ActiveX object that is associated with a linked or embedded OLE object in a control. By using this reference, you can access the properties or invoke the methods of the OLE object. Read-only Object.

properties.name: Left
properties.description: Use the Left property to specify an object's location on a form or report. Read/write Integer.

properties.name: Top
properties.description: Use the Top property to specify an object's location on a form or report. Read/write Integer.

properties.name: Width
properties.description: Gets or sets the width of the specified object in twips. Read/write Integer.

properties.name: Height
properties.description: Gets or sets the height of the specified object in twips. Read/write Integer.

properties.name: SpecialEffect
properties.description: Use the SpecialEffect property to specify whether special formatting will apply to the specified object. Read/write Byte.

properties.name: BorderStyle
properties.description: Specifies how a control's border appears. Read/write Byte.

properties.name: BorderColor
properties.description: Use the BorderColor property to specify the color of a control's border. Read/write Long.

properties.name: BorderWidth
properties.description: Use the BorderWidth property to specify the width of a control's border. Read/write Byte.

properties.name: Section
properties.description: You can identify these controls by the section of a form or report where the control appears. Read/write Integer.

properties.name: OnMouseDown
properties.description: Sets or returns the value of the On Mouse Down box in the Properties window. Read/write String.

properties.name: OnMouseMove
properties.description: Sets or returns the value of the On Mouse Move box in the Properties window. Read/write String.

properties.name: OnMouseUp
properties.description: Sets or returns the value of the On Mouse Up box in the Properties window. Read/write String.

properties.name: OnKeyDown
properties.description: Sets or returns the value of the On Key Down box in the Properties window. Read/write String.

properties.name: OnKeyUp
properties.description: Sets or returns the value of the On Key Up box in the Properties window. Read/write String.

properties.name: OnKeyPress
properties.description: Sets or returns the value of the On Key Press box in the Properties window. Read/write String.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: Use the Name property to specify or determine the string expression that identifies the name of an object. Read/write String.

properties.name: Layout
properties.description: Returns the type of layout for the specified control. Read-only AcLayoutType.

properties.name: LeftPadding
properties.description: Gets or sets the amount of space (in inches) between the control and its left gridline. Read/write Integer.

properties.name: TopPadding
properties.description: Gets or sets the amount of space (in inches) between the control and its top gridline. Read/write Integer.

properties.name: RightPadding
properties.description: Gets or sets the amount of space (in inches) between the control and its right gridline. Read/write Integer.

properties.name: BottomPadding
properties.description: Gets or sets the amount of space (in inches) between the control and its bottom gridline. Read/write Integer.

properties.name: GridlineStyleLeft
properties.description: Gets or sets the left gridline style of the specified control. Read/write Byte.

properties.name: GridlineStyleTop
properties.description: Gets or sets the top gridline style of the specified control. Read/write Byte.

properties.name: GridlineStyleRight
properties.description: Gets or sets the right gridline style of the specified control. Read/write Byte.

properties.name: GridlineStyleBottom
properties.description: Gets or sets the bottom gridline style of the specified control. Read/write Byte.

properties.name: GridlineWidthLeft
properties.description: Gets or sets the width of the left gridline for the specified control. Read/write Byte.

properties.name: GridlineWidthTop
properties.description: Gets or sets the width of the top gridline for the specified control. Read/write Byte.

properties.name: GridlineWidthRight
properties.description: Gets or sets the width of the right gridline for the specified control. Read/write Byte.

properties.name: GridlineWidthBottom
properties.description: Gets or sets the width of the bottom gridline for the specified control. Read/write Byte.

properties.name: GridlineColor
properties.description: Gets or sets the color of the gridline for the specified control. Read/write Long.

properties.name: HorizontalAnchor
properties.description: Gets or sets an AcHorizontalAnchor constant that indicates how the control is anchored horizontally within its layout. Read/write.

properties.name: VerticalAnchor
properties.description: Gets or sets an AcVerticalAnchor constant that indicates how the specified control is anchored vertically within its layout. Read/write.

properties.name: LayoutID
properties.description: Returns the unique identifier for the layout that contains the specified control. Read-only Long.

properties.name: OnBeforeNavigate
properties.description: Gets or sets the value of the On Before Navigate box in the property sheet of a web browser control. Read/write String.

properties.name: OnDocumentComplete
properties.description: Gets or sets the value of the On Document Complete box in the property sheet of a web browser control. Read/write String.

properties.name: OnNavigateError
properties.description: Gets or sets the value of the On Navigate Error box in the property sheet of a web browser control. Read/write String.

properties.name: OnProgressChange
properties.description: Gets or sets the value of the On Progress Change box in the property sheet of a web browser control. Read/write String.

properties.name: OnUpdated
properties.description: Sets or returns the value of the On Updated box in the Properties window of a form or report. Read/write String.

properties.name: TabStop
properties.description: Use the TabStop property to specify whether you can use the Tab key to move the focus to a control. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: TabIndex
properties.description: Use the TabIndex property to specify a control's place in the tab order on a form or report. Read/write Integer.

properties.name: Visible
properties.description: Returns or sets whether the object is visible. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: InSelection
properties.description: Use the InSelection property to determine or specify whether a control on a form in Design view is selected. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: ControlType
properties.description: Use the ControlType property in Visual Basic to determine the type of control on a form or report. Read/write Byte.

properties.name: BorderThemeColorIndex
properties.description: Gets or sets a value that represents a color in the applied color theme associated with the BorderColor property of the specified object. Read/write Long.

properties.name: BorderTint
properties.description: Gets or sets the tint that is applied to the theme color in the BorderColor property of the specified object. Read/write Single.

properties.name: BorderShade
properties.description: Gets or sets the shade applied to the theme color in the BorderColor property of the specified object. Read/write Single.

properties.name: GridlineThemeColorIndex
properties.description: Gets or sets the theme color index that represents a color in the applied color theme associated with the GridlineColor property of the specified object. Read/write Long.

properties.name: GridlineTint
properties.description: Gets or sets the tint applied to the theme color in the GridlineColor property of the specified object. Read/write Single.

properties.name: GridlineShade
properties.description: Gets or sets the shade applied to the theme color in the GridlineColor property of the specified object. Read/write Single.

properties.name: StatusBarText
properties.description: Use the StatusBarText property to specify the text that is displayed in the status bar when a control is selected. Read/write String.

properties.name: ControlTipText
properties.description: Use the ControlTipText property to specify the text that appears in a ScreenTip when you hold the mouse pointer over a control. Read/write String.

properties.name: EventProcPrefix
properties.description: Gets or sets the prefix portion of an event procedure name. Read/write String.

properties.name: HelpContextId
properties.description: The HelpContextID property specifies the context ID of a topic in the custom Help file specified by the HelpFile property setting. Read/write Long.

properties.name: Tag
properties.description: Stores extra information about a form, report, section, or control needed by a Microsoft Access application. Read/write String.

methods.name: Undo
methods.description: Use the Undo method to reset a control or form when its value has been changed.

methods.name: SizeToFit
methods.description: Use the SizeToFit method to size a control so that it fits the text or image that it contains.

methods.name: Requery
methods.description: The Requery method updates the data underlying a specified control that's on the active form by requerying the source of data for the control.

methods.name: SetFocus
methods.description: The SetFocus method moves the focus to the specified form, the specified control on the active form, or the specified field on the active datasheet.

methods.name: Move
methods.signature: Move(Left As Variant, [Top As Variant], [Width As Variant], [Height As Variant])
methods.description: Moves the specified object to the coordinates specified by the argument values.

parameters.name: Left
parameters.description: The screen position in twips for the left edge of the object relative to the left edge of the Microsoft Access window.

parameters.name: Top
parameters.description: The screen position in twips for the top edge of the object relative to the top edge of the Access window.

parameters.name: Width
parameters.description: The desired width of the object in twips.

parameters.name: Height
parameters.description: The desired height of the object in twips.

events.name: Updated
events.description: The Updated event occurs when an OLE object's data has been modified.

events.name: BeforeUpdate
events.description: The BeforeUpdate event occurs before changed data in a control or record is updated.

parameters.name: Cancel
parameters.description: The setting determines if the BeforeUpdate event occurs. Setting the Cancel argument to True (1) cancels the BeforeUpdate event.

events.name: AfterUpdate
events.description: The AfterUpdate event occurs after changed data in a control or record is updated.

events.name: Enter
events.description: The Enter event occurs before a control actually receives the focus from a control on the same form or report.

events.name: Exit
events.description: The Exit event occurs just before a control loses the focus to another control on the same form or report.

parameters.name: Cancel
parameters.description: Set to True to cancel the event.

events.name: Dirty
events.description: The Dirty event occurs when the contents of the specified control changes.

parameters.name: Cancel
parameters.description: The setting determines if the Dirty event occurs. Setting the Cancel argument to True (1) cancels the Dirty event.

events.name: Change
events.description: The Change event occurs when the contents of the specified control change.

events.name: GotFocus
events.description: The GotFocus event occurs when the specified object receives the focus.

events.name: LostFocus
events.description: The LostFocus event occurs when the specified object loses the focus.

events.name: Click
events.description: The Click event occurs when the user presses and then releases a mouse button over an object.

events.name: DblClick
events.description: The DblClick event occurs when the user presses and releases the left mouse button twice over an object within the double-click time limit of the system.

parameters.name: Cancel
parameters.description: The setting determines if the DblClick event occurs. Setting the Cancel argument to True (1) cancels the DblClick event.

events.name: MouseDown
events.signature: MouseDown(Button As Integer, Shift As Integer, X As Single, Y As Single)
events.description: The MouseDown event occurs when the user presses a mouse button.

parameters.name: Button
parameters.description:
The button that was pressed to trigger the event. If you need to test for the Button argument, you can use one of the following intrinsic constants as bit masks:

  • acLeftButton The bit mask for the left mouse button.

  • acRightButton The bit mask for the right mouse button.

  • acMiddleButton The bit mask for the middle mouse button.

parameters.name: Shift
parameters.description:
The state of the Shift, Ctrl, and Alt keys when the button specified by the Button argument was pressed or released. If you need to test for the Shift argument, you can use one of the following intrinsic constants as bit masks:

  • acShiftMask The bit mask for the Shift key.

  • acCtrlMask The bit mask for the Ctrl key.

  • acAltMask The bit mask for the Alt key.

parameters.name: X
parameters.description: The x coordinate for the current location of the mouse pointer, in twips.

parameters.name: Y
parameters.description: The y coordinate for the current location of the mouse pointer, in twips.

parameters.name: Shift

parameters.name: X
parameters.description: The x coordinate for the current location of the mouse pointer, in twips.

parameters.name: Y

  • acShiftMask The bit mask for the Shift key.

parameters.name: X

events.name: KeyDown
events.signature: KeyDown(KeyCode As Integer, Shift As Integer)
events.description: The KeyDown event occurs when the user presses a key while a form or control has the focus. This event also occurs if you send a keystroke to a form or control by using the SendKeys action in a macro or the SendKeys statement in Visual Basic.

parameters.name: KeyCode
parameters.description: A key code, such as vbKeyF1 (the F1 key) or vbKeyHome (the Home key). To specify key codes, use the intrinsic constants shown in the Object Browser. You can prevent an object from receiving a keystroke by setting KeyCode to 0.

parameters.name: Shift
parameters.description:
The state of the Shift, Ctrl, and Alt keys at the time of the event. If you need to test for the Shift argument, you can use one of the following intrinsic constants as bit masks:

  • acShiftMask The bit mask for the Shift key.

  • acCtrlMask The bit mask for the Ctrl key.

  • acAltMask The bit mask for the Alt key.

events.name: KeyPress
events.description: The KeyPress event occurs when the user presses and releases a key or key combination that corresponds to an ANSI code while a form or control has the focus. This event also occurs if you send an ANSI keystroke to a form or control by using the SendKeys action in a macro or the SendKeys statement in Visual Basic.

parameters.name: KeyAscii
parameters.description: Returns a numeric ANSI key code. The KeyAscii argument is passed by reference; changing it sends a different character to the object. Setting the KeyAscii argument to 0 cancels the keystroke so that the object doesn't recognize that a key was pressed.

events.name: KeyUp
events.signature: KeyUp(KeyCode As Integer, Shift As Integer)
events.description: The KeyUp event occurs when the user releases a key while a form or control has the focus. This event also occurs if you send a keystroke to a form or control by using the SendKeys action in a macro or the SendKeys statement in Visual Basic.

parameters.name: KeyCode
parameters.description: A key code, such as vbKeyF1 (the F1 key) or vbKeyHome (the Home key). To specify key codes, use the intrinsic constants shown in the Object Browser. You can prevent an object from receiving a keystroke by setting KeyCode to 0.

parameters.name: Shift
parameters.description:
The state of the Shift, Ctrl, and Alt keys at the time of the event. If you need to test for the Shift argument, you can use one of the following intrinsic constants as bit masks:

  • acShiftMask The bit mask for the Shift key.

  • acCtrlMask The bit mask for the Ctrl key.

  • acAltMask The bit mask for the Alt key.

events.name: BeforeNavigate2
events.signature: BeforeNavigate2(pDisp As Object, URL As Variant, flags As Variant, TargetFrameName As Variant, PostData As Variant, Headers As Variant, Cancel As Boolean)
events.description: Occurs before navigation occurs in the given WebBrowserControl.

parameters.name: pDisp
parameters.description: A pointer to the IDispatch interface for the WebBrowserControl object that represents the window or frame.

parameters.name: URL
parameters.description: Contains the URL to be navigated to.

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: Reserved. Must be set to Null.

parameters.name: TargetFrameName
parameters.description: Contains the name of the frame in which to display the resource, or Null if no named frame is targeted for the resource.

parameters.name: PostData
parameters.description: Contains the data to send to the server, if the HTTP POST transaction is used.

parameters.name: Headers
parameters.description: Contains additional HTTP headers to send to the server (HTTP URLs only). The headers can specify information, such as the action required of the server, the type of data being passed to the server, or a status code.

parameters.name: Cancel
parameters.description: Contains the cancel flag. Set to True to cancel the navigation operation.

events.name: DocumentComplete
events.signature: DocumentComplete(pDisp As Object, URL As Variant)
events.description: Occurs when a document is completely loaded and initialized.

parameters.name: pDisp
parameters.description: A pointer to the IDispatch interface of the window or frame in which the document is loaded.

parameters.name: URL
parameters.description: Contains the URL of the loaded document.

events.name: ProgressChange
events.signature: ProgressChange(Progress As Long, ProgressMax As Long)
events.description: Occurs when the progress of a download operation is updated.

parameters.name: Progress
parameters.description: Specifies the amount of total progress to show, or -1 when progress is complete.

parameters.name: ProgressMax
parameters.description: Specifies the maximum progress value.

events.name: NavigateError
events.signature: NavigateError(pDisp As Object, URL As Variant, TargetFrameName As Variant, StatusCode As Variant, Cancel As Boolean)
events.description: Occurs when an error occurs during navigation.

parameters.name: pDisp
parameters.description: A pointer to an IDispatch interface for the WebBrowserControl object that represents the window or frame in which the navigation error occurred.

parameters.name: URL
parameters.description: Contains the URL for which navigation failed.

parameters.name: TargetFrameName
parameters.description: Contains the name of the frame in which to display the resource, or Null if no named frame was targeted for the resource.

parameters.name: StatusCode
parameters.description: Contains an error status code, if available.

parameters.name: Cancel
parameters.description: Specifies whether to cancel the navigation to an error page or to any further autosearch.
